MAR.note: Press release on a customs AI project; states nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.

facts.fact: Morocco's customs administration (ADII), with the World Customs Organization and Swiss SECO, launched a project on 19 May 2025 to integrate AI into customs risk analysis and targeting, and a first technical mission ran 19-23 May 2025 assessing current capacity.
